material.acceptance_criteria: The phone-width HUD text size is a value the project records, and play.html sets that value.
material.description: play.html:139 sets #ui-left #hud and #status to font-size 10px inside @media (max-width: 600px). WCAG sets no fixed pixel floor, so the legible minimum is a project decision that this row must record before any change. Related but distinct: device-phone-layout-overlap-375 (panel overlap at 375x667). Kalbag: HUD text must be legible for every player.

notes.note: Kept as a measurable defect. Verified at origin/main d821e361: play.html:139 `#ui-left #hud, #ui-left #status { font-size: 10px; }` inside the @media (max-width:600px) block that starts at play.html:137. Compares to --t-body 12px (play.html:85). Observable: on phones the HUD and status text render at 10px, smaller than the body size. The legibility floor is still undecided (acceptance asks the project to record it).

Published 5b581bab (#ui-left #hud and #status at var(--t-body) 12px inside max-width 600px). Recorded floor: 12px body token. CI failure is the a21e626e panels_route test. Witness not taken: needs a live match at 375x667; blocked_by lobby-disabled-when-one-relay-503 (pending).

material.subject: Phone-width HUD text is set to 10px
material.witness: Live Pages play.html, cdp: at 375x667 #ui-left #hud 12px and #status 12px, --t-body 12px; at 1280x720 #hud 12px. Floor is the 12px body token. Fix 5b581bab on origin tip. CI on tip 7f68d3bcc7c7356b1291ccec7eda0b23ad2a89f2 green (ci-status 6/6 success, run 40128978828).
material.witness_plan: Load play.html at 375px width and read getComputedStyle font-size for #ui-left #hud and #status; close when the value equals the recorded project minimum.
